name: inspect_native_load_image
title: Inspect Native Load Image
description: Verify the provider's loaded DOS MZ or explicitly selected COM image against its immutable target snapshot: complete original/modified source-byte digests, header/module file mappings and memory digests, relocations and external entry. Returns measured observations and independent checks with mismatch coordinates. COM verification includes its imposed entry register context and does not claim PSP/runtime coverage. Overlay and uninitialized coverage remain explicit; other formats return unsupported. Does not execute or modify the target.

name: list_procedures
title: List Procedures
description: List every analyzed procedure as address/value pairs after provider analysis. Ghidra metadata distinguishes thunks and external functions; use returned addresses in later function operations. Select detail summary for counts and retained native-inventory pages; complete remains the default.

name: procedure_info
title: Procedure Info
description: Return provider metadata for one procedure identified by symbol or address: entrypoint, signature, locals, size, block count, and complete inclusive body ranges when observed. Extents reflect the provider's analyzed body; Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut it are reported in Evidence limitations. Hopper locals preserve observed names and signed stack displacements; source types remain unknown. Body byte count and enclosing span remain distinct; unavailable extent is explicit.

name: procedure_pseudo_code
title: Procedure Pseudo Code
description: Decompile one analyzed procedure by symbol name or provider-normalized address. Ghidra also accepts file-offset:0x... selectors and falls back to a unique source-file mapping when a 0x-prefixed number resolves to no procedure; existing analysis addresses take precedence and ambiguous mappings fail explicitly. Returns provider-specific pseudocode, never original source or cross-provider text equivalence, and may return null; request procedure_assembly when instruction precision matters. Ghidra no-return assumptions may cut the analyzed body; Evidence limitations report observed terminal calls and available callee identities.

name: analyze_function
title: Analyze Function
description: Build a dossier for one native function identified by symbol or provider-returned address. Returns identity with complete inclusive analyzed body ranges or explicit unknown, provider-specific pseudocode and assembly, comments, calls, references, referenced strings/names, local CFG blocks, and available native API boundary observations. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in limitations with available callee identities. Default detail summary returns a compact dossier (identity, pseudocode size, facet counts, value-flow availability) and retains the complete dossier Evidence in this session; page pseudocode, references, assembly and value-flow through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id with inspect_analysis_view. detail complete returns the full dossier inline.

detail.description: summary (default) returns a compact dossier and retains the complete analyze_function Evidence in this session; page pseudocode, references and value-flow through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id with inspect_analysis_view. complete returns the full dossier inline.

name: open_binary
title: Open Binary
description: Open a local executable, application bundle, archive, JavaScript, source map, plist, or analysis database after validation. format=dos-com explicitly interprets 1..65280 headerless bytes as a DOS COM analysis image. format=raw-binary interprets headerless bytes with a required architecture and entry_point; file offset 0 maps at that address. Omission preserves header-based detection. provider_id selects one deep provider or deterministic auto selection; the binding remains stable until close or an explicit switch, with no failure fallback. Reopening the same target and profile retains its active database and metadata edits. An optional analysis snapshot is imported atomically and must match the binary identity, concrete provider, and canonical analysis profile exactly; importing into a session with metadata mutations requires closing and reopening it first. Call close_binary when the investigation is finished.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis target; relative paths are rejected.

format.description: Explicit interpretation: dos-com or raw-binary (headerless), or gamecube-dol (GameCube/Wii DOL, never auto-detected). Omission preserves header-based detection.

architecture.description: Caller-supplied CPU family. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. format=gamecube-dol takes powerpc from the header, so it must be omitted.

entry_point.description: Caller-supplied load and entry address (0xhex). File offset 0 is mapped here. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. Optional with format=gamecube-dol; must equal the DOL header entry.

provider_id.description: Exact deep-analysis provider ID, or automatic selection when omitted.

snapshot_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.

entry_point.description: Canonical caller-selected address where raw file offset 0 is mapped and execution is seeded.
Canonical entry address taken from the caller-selected DOL header.

name: close_binary
title: Close Binary
description: When the investigation is finished, drain earlier provider requests, optionally write a provider-neutral analysis snapshot atomically to the caller-supplied path, then close the active analysis session and every provider resource started for it. Resource-only app sessions have no binary snapshot binding, so close them without snapshot_path. Later provider requests wait until this lifecycle operation finishes. Existing files require explicit overwrite; a failed save leaves the session open so cached analysis is not lost. Metadata edits prevent immutable snapshot saves until the session is recreated; export_evidence_bundle preserves mutable observations before closing without a snapshot.

snapshot_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.

overwrite.description: Whether an existing destination may be replaced.

evidence_records.description: All retained Evidence records, including observations without replay bindings.

name: binary_session
title: Binary Session
description: Report the active binary target or resource-only app root, provider and capability availability when applicable, client-feature, analysis, and server-identity status without starting analysis.

expected_server_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path expected for the running server; relative paths are rejected.

name: export_evidence_bundle
title: Export Evidence Bundle
description: Atomically write the session's deterministic Evidence bundle to the requested local path. Existing files require overwrite: true; records and manifests use canonical byte-stable ordering.
